name: Saris & Shawls of the World
subtitle: Kanchipuram, Paithani & more
shortDescription: 8 sari and shawl weaving traditions to play: Maheshwari saree, Kullu shawl weaving, Kanchipuram silk sari and Paithani.
longDescription:
Saris & Shawls of the World: 8 sari and shawl weaving traditions from across India, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Maheshwari saree, Kullu shawl weaving, Kanchipuram silk sari, Paithani, Chanderi sari, Baluchari sari, Mekhela sador weaving and Banarasi brocade.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can set the loom, throw the shuttle and weave borders and motifs into saris and shawls, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
